## **M &M Mining International**
is a specialized Mining & Supply top-quality metals and industrial minerals sourced directly from Hindu Kush. We proudly serve clients across the United Kingdom, acting as a reliable Supplier partner that ensures every shipment meets the highest standards of quality, compliance, and timely delivery.
Our experienced team plays a crucial role in connecting the abundant mineral resources from our privately owned mines, located in the mineral-rich zones of Northwest Hindu Kush, are renowned for their abundant reserves of high-quality minerals with the growing industrial demands of the UK. With a focus on transparency, professionalism, and long-term relationships, we streamline the supply chain and offer tailored mining solutions that support the strategic goals of our clients.
###  Vision 
To become the leading mining services partner for UK-based businesses, offering smart, sustainable, and scalable sourcing solutions for mineral and metal resources worldwide. 
###  Mission 
To empower UK & Europe industries by providing reliable, efficient, and ethical sourcing of metals and minerals from Hindu Kush, ensuring cost-effectiveness, and seamless supply chain support.

## Industries We Serve in UK
At M&M Mining International, we proudly serve a wide range of industries across the UK by Mining and supplying high-quality minerals and metals directly from Hindu Kush. Our services cater to key sectors including construction, steel and metal fabrication, ceramics, glass, electronics, water treatment, paints, agriculture, and energy storage. Each industry relies on precise materials, and we ensure timely, reliable, and compliant delivery every time. With a deep understanding of UK market standards and industrial needs, we stand as a trusted Mining partner, dedicated to supporting sustainable growth and operational excellence across diverse British industries.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Construction-Infrastructure.webp)
## Construction & Infrastructure
Our sandstone, granite, marble, and iron ore support UK construction projects with durable, high-quality materials for strong infrastructure.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Ceramic-Glass-Industry.webp)
## Ceramic & Glass Industry
We provide feldspar, quartz, and ceramic bodies that meet the UK ceramic and glass industry’s quality and thermal resistance requirements.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Steel-Metal-Fabrication.webp)
## Steel & Metal Fabrication
Our iron ore, manganese, and chromite are key materials for UK steel and alloy industries, supporting construction and manufacturing sectors.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Fertilizer-Agriculture.webp)
## Fertilizer & Agriculture 
We mine potash and rock phosphate for UK fertilizer production, ensuring nutrient-rich soil and higher crop yields for agricultural sectors.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Electronics-Electrical.webp)
## Electronics & Electrical
We deliver copper, antimony, and silver ores vital for UK electronics and wiring applications in energy, telecom, and industrial sectors.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Battery-Energy-Storage.webp)
## Battery & Energy Storage
We mine nickel, manganese, and copper ores essential for UK battery and energy storage technologies, supporting future-ready infrastructure.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Paints-Coating-Industry.webp)
## Paints & Coating Industry
We mine minerals like dolomite and feldspar essential for UK paint and coating manufacturers, ensuring smooth texture and lasting quality.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Water-Filtration-Environmental.webp)
## Water Filtration & Environmental
Our pure silica sand and quartz support UK water treatment facilities, helping industries maintain environmental standards and water systems.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Interior-Design-Decorative-Stone.webp)
## Interior Design & Decorative Stone
We mine high-grade marble, granite, and sandstone from Hindu Kush to enhance UK interior design with premium decorative natural stones.
![](https://mmm-int.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Industrial-Abrasives-Refractories.webp)
## Industrial Abrasives & Refractories
Our quartz, silica sand, and feldspar are ideal for abrasive tools and refractory bricks used in UK heavy manufacturing and processing industries.

## Shipping, Returns, and Refund Policy

This Shipping, Returns, and Refund Policy applies to all transactions conducted with M&M Mining International, a UK-based mining service provider sourcing industrial minerals and metals from Hindu Kush. This policy outlines the procedures and responsibilities related to international deliveries, return eligibility, and refund claims.
By placing an order with M&M Mining International, clients agree to the terms described herein.
## Shipping Policy
### Delivery Scope
We ship industrial mineral and metal products from verified suppliers in Hindu Kush to clients across the United Kingdom. Each order is arranged through secure freight and logistics channels, in compliance with UK customs and import regulations.
### Delivery Timelines
Delivery timeframes vary depending on the type of material, volume, and shipping method selected. Estimated lead times are:
  * **Bulk shipments (containers):** 3–6 weeks
  * **Sample shipments:** 7–14 business days
  * **Custom orders:** May take longer, depending on material availability and testing


Delays caused by customs, weather, strikes, or force majeure events are beyond our control. We will notify clients promptly of any disruptions.
### Shipping Costs
Shipping costs are determined by:
  * Order size and weight
  * Freight method (sea, air, land)
  * Destination port or warehouse address


All costs will be clearly stated in the quotation or invoice before shipment.
### Delivery Confirmation
A shipping notice and tracking details will be shared with clients once goods are dispatched. Clients are responsible for ensuring the correct delivery address and for being available to receive the shipment.
## Returns Policy
Due to the nature of industrial materials, we do not accept returns for:
  * Opened packaging or processed materials
  * Materials that have been tested or altered
  * Products that have passed third-party inspection at the buyer’s request


However, we will consider returns or replacements in the following situations:
  * Incorrect material or grade delivered
  * Damage in transit (reported within 48 hours of delivery)
  * Quality variance that significantly differs from the agreed sample or specification (with supporting documentation)


Clients must contact us immediately at **info@mmm-int.co.uk** and provide photographic evidence, test reports (if applicable), and shipment references.
## Refund Policy &
Refunds may be issued in the following cases:
  * Order cancellation before dispatch (partial or full depending on stage of processing)
  * Verified defect or wrong material shipment not resolved by replacement
  * Shipment loss confirmed by the freight provider


Refunds will be processed within **14 business days** of claim approval. Refunds are issued via the original method of payment or through bank transfer, depending on the agreement.
Please note: Refunds will **not** be granted for delays caused by customs or external shipping events.
## Order Cancellations
Clients may request order cancellations before the dispatch stage. However, cancellations are subject to:
  * A processing fee if goods have already been prepared or packed
  * Rejection if the order is already in transit or if the material was custom-processed


To cancel an order, email us at **info@mmm-int.co.uk** with your invoice or order number.
## Risk of Loss
All items purchased from M&M Mining International are shipped FOB (Free on Board) unless otherwise agreed in writing. Once goods are handed over to the shipping carrier, the risk of loss or damage transfers to the client.
Insurance can be arranged at the client’s request for additional cost.
## Governing Law
This policy is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes will be handled under UK jurisdiction.
